Objection: If God Exists, Why Is He Hidden?
ObjectionSummary: If God wanted a relationship with us, He would make Himself obvious. His hiddenness suggests He is not there.
Response: Hiddenness is a real struggle, and Scripture voices it (Psalm 10:1; Job). Yet Christianity claims God has revealed Himself - in creation, in conscience, in Israel's story, and decisively in Jesus - while respecting human freedom: overwhelming proof would compel assent but not love. God reveals enough to seek Him and hides enough that seeking is real. Many who sought honestly report they found Him.
